integrity: The exact characterizations and welfare claims are supported by an explicit proof and independently coded finite direct checks; literature priority remains subject to specialist confirmation. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-sized classes, uniform pairwise symmetric signed valuations, unrestricted coalitions, and unilateral strict Nash deviations only; outside these hypotheses no statement is established. Finite verification supplements but does not prove the infinite theorem.
title: Exact Nash phase diagram and resonant welfare loss in balanced signed coalition games
